Grading Rubric (80 Points Total)

  • Manual Ground Truth Precision (4 pts / 32 pts scaled): The five hand-authored commentary notes exhibit genuine scholarly depth, accurate historical context, verified philological definitions, and exact textual citations.
  • Standoff TEI Markup Validity (3 pts / 24 pts scaled): The <standOff> container is well-formed, all @target URI pointers include the required # prefix and resolve to valid xml:id anchors, and provenance is recorded via @resp.
  • Comparative Three-Way Audit & Reflection (3 pts / 24 pts scaled): The 300–500 word reflection in COMMENTARY.md insightfully compares precision, recall, speed, and error profiles across manual, rule-based, and AI methods, documenting vetted and rejected claims.
